cohort: The participants were autistic children aged 3-15 years, predominantly male and born term, recruited from centers for autistic children and a psychiatry unit in Iraq.
finding: The study found significant associations between inter-pregnancy interval and gestational age at birth, maternal age at childbirth, and antenatal care in the cohort of autistic children.
mod_finding: Approximately two-thirds of the autistic children in the cohort were born via cesarean section.
